newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB Australia wheat indicator prices - June 17.
newsitem.headline: AWB Australia wheat indicator prices - June 17.

text.p: Australian Wheat Board international card prices for wheat exports for June 17
In U.S. dollars per tonne, FOB eastern states, with variation on previous day in second column of each grade.
ASW AH PH 13 PCT PH 14 PCT
Note: ASW = Australian Standard White; AH = Australian Hard; PH = Australian Prime Hard; percentages = protein content.
Australian Wheat Board indicator prices for multi-grade contracts for 1997/98 crop wheat decreased by A$2.50 per tonne.
Indicator Prices in A$ per tonne:
Indicator prices on a delivered port basis:
AWB MARKET COMMENTARY: Improved weather conditions in India, U.S. and Canada and showers in Australia plus the lack of export buyers pressured prices overnight.

NOTE: The indicator price represents the current state of the international wheat market. It is a cash contract fob price quoted on a delivered port basis, offered today by the AWB for wheat delivered during the 1997/98 harvest. The offer is valid until 4.30 p.m. Australian Eastern Standard Time (0630 GMT).
